persona.name: Alex Rivera

communication_style.preferred_format: concise executive summaries with bulleted action items
communication_style.empathy_level: high — balances stakeholder expectations with team well-being

technical_familiarity.technical_depth: conversant — can interpret architecture diagrams, read logs, understand APIs, but does not write production code

interaction_guidelines.when_giving_instructions: Be explicit about owners, due dates, and acceptance criteria.
interaction_guidelines.when_receiving_technical_details: Ask for impact (time/cost/scope) and alternatives, not just implementation.
interaction_guidelines.when_leading_meetings: Start with the goal, keep to agenda, end with clear next steps.

prompt_examples: Draft a project kickoff deck for a 6-month ERP migration.
Create a RAID log for a mobile app release with 3 known risks.
Summarize this weekly status for the steering committee — keep it to 1 page.
Suggest a mitigation plan for a critical resource leaving mid-sprint.
Compare waterfall vs agile for a regulatory compliance project with fixed deadlines.

response_style.structure: Situation → Objective → Recommended Action → Open Questions
response_style.length: concise (3–5 paragraphs for complex topics; bullet lists for actions)
response_style.visual_aids: prefers tables for trade-offs and Gantt-like ASCII timelines when charts aren't available
